title: Computer-Use Agents Are Embodied Generalists
why: A single CUA acts via screenshots and keyboard/mouse on task GUIs, transferring grounding and clicking to embodied workshop tasks.
mechanism: Wraps embodied tasks as screen apps so one CUA, using the same screenshot observation and keyboard/mouse action space as ordinary software, performs navigation, 3D affordance, and video-segmentation competitions; argues CUA visual grounding, precise clicking, and exploration transfer to embodied settings.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: same untuned CUA (Gemini 3.5/3.6 Flash) placed 1st/2nd/3rd/6th across four ECCV workshop competitions; GUI vs matching API stayed within four points on validation subsets (GUI higher on two of four); a preliminary Qwen3.5 9B writing actions as text matched π0.5 (56% vs 59%) on 1,000 unseen dual-arm sim instances.
evidence_locator: arXiv abs citation_abstract and dateline (Submitted on 6 Nov 2026; cs.LG, cs.RO); project page results (OpenSUN3D/MeViSv2/DialNav/VLNVerse) and GUI-vs-API table
retrieval_notes: Found in Monday 9 Nov 2026 cs.LG pastweek/new listing. Opened abs page (title/abstract/subjects) and project page https://pranjal2041.github.io/cua-embodied. PDF not deep-read → needs_fulltext. Not in corpus/inbox.

title: Cogito, Ergo Feci: False Success, the Limits of Weight Surgery, and What an External Verifier Catches in a Computer-Use Agent
why: Diagnoses CUA false-done failures on OSWorld and tests weight edits versus an external final-screen verifier.
mechanism: Studies the CUA stopping/feedback loop: Holo-3.1-4B declares tasks done on OSWorld when the official evaluator scores 0; tests training-free activation/weight edits against a pre-registered gate, and an external verifier (Feci Guard) that checks each requirement on the final screenshot.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported (PDF abstract and repo TL;DR, recomputed from committed data): 56.7% on 119 OSWorld diagnostic tasks; 29/51 failures (57%) are false done; self-judge near chance (53% detect / 48% false reject); no weight-edit arm beats run-to-run noise (merge +1.9 [−4.3, +8.0], n=165); Feci Guard offline detects 68% of false successes and rejects 10% of true ones; online false-done 22.5%→10.8% but authors do not attribute the drop to the guard; score +1.6 [−4.4, +7.7].
evidence_locator: Opened paper/main.pdf title page, abstract, keywords, and Figure 1 / start of §1 (pdftotext pp.1–2); GitHub README abstract/TL;DR. Header: PREPRINT · NOVEMBER 9, 2026. arXiv: forthcoming.
